# stackit_loadbalancer_ip_list (Resource)

Load Balancer IP Lists resource schema.

~> This resource is part of the experimental feature loadbalancer-ip-list and is likely going to undergo significant changes or be removed in the future. Use it at your own discretion.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `file_content` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Raw upload payload as a plain UTF-8 string. Newline-separated .txt list of IPv4 CIDR entries, or CSV with cidr,labels columns (any other columns are ignored). Write-only - never stored in state and never returned by the API. To rotate the content, update this value AND increment file_content_version. Changing this field alone will NOT trigger an update.
- `file_content_version` (Number) User-managed rotation counter for the file_content. Must be incremented every time file_content is changed. Terraform diffs this field to detect changes in the defined IP list - changing file_content alone will NOT trigger an update because it is write-only and never stored in state.
- `name` (String) Name of the Load Balancer IP List.
- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID to which the Load Balancer is associated.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined metadata as key-value pairs. Should not exceed 64 entries.
- `region` (String) STACKIT region.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) Unique SHA-256 hex fingerprint used to verify the stored IP list file content.
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID. It is structured as "`project_id`,region,`name`".
- `number_of_ips` (Number) The number of IP addresses in this IP list.
